skill.summary: Manage TickTick tasks (add, list, complete) via the local `tickrs` CLI.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ticktick-linux skill:

- Manage TickTick tasks on Linux via the local tickrs CLI.
- Add, list (with status and project filters), and complete tasks.
- List all projects.
- Requires CLI authentication and TickTick API credentials.
